texts: mixed: everything the sentence says is captured and the rule fires per convening; the only shortfall is that the parser dropped the link making mire-essence a kind of essence, which it did emit for your near-identical 'Whenever the Council meets' sentence — so this is parser variance, not your phrasing. No rewrite of this sentence would change it; if you want that link guaranteed, state it once in the item, e.g. 'Mire-essence is a kind of essence.'
